# Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink

Store Managed Flink applications, configuration, versions and snapshots without running jobs.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `kinesisanalyticsv2` |
| Signing name | `kinesisanalytics` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2018-05-23` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records only |
| Selected operations | 20 of 33 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#amazon-managed-service-for-apache-flink) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Records only, no Flink runtime: no jobs, workers, networking, checkpoints, restore, logs, metrics or results are executed or produced.
- DescribeApplication returns the current lifecycle state then advances it; DELETING removes the application after that read; lists and inventory do not advance state; snapshots contain no job state and normal stop creates no automatic snapshot.
- SQL-1_0, Zeppelin Studio notebooks and FLINK-2_x runtimes are explicitly rejected; SQL inputs/outputs, interactive sessions, maintenance, rollback, encryption, conditional tokens and operation history are unsupported.
- IAM role existence and trust are not checked by the service; environment and runtime settings are metadata, not resource allocation.
- No CloudFormation provider; application deletion accepts READY or RUNNING and removes snapshot and version history; S3 validation reads the object before the application transaction.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
